title: Virginia Aquarium Boat Tours
specs: See bottlenose dolphins, humpback whales, seabirds, sea turtles, and other coastal wildlife

All ages welcome; tours may not be appropriate for younger guests

gap: Exact price for whale watching tour not stated
blurb: Guests join knowledgeable educators on the Atlantic Explorer to see bottlenose dolphins, whales, seabirds, sea turtles, and other coastal Virginia animals. Tours last approximately 90 minutes and are weather-dependent. Sightings of dolphins and whales are not guaranteed.
extraNote: Tickets are non-refundable unless the tour is canceled by the captain · Tours are weather-dependent · Advanced online reservations strongly encouraged · Discounts available for groups of 15 or more · No alcohol or large coolers permitted aboard · Backpacks or large bags must be left locked in car · Aquarium Boat Dock near the outdoor Seal Exhibit · Dolphin tours from spring into fall; whale watching tours during winter
